sources.title: Asaf Karagila, Zornian Functional Analysis (revision 7 October 2020)
sources.locator: Definition 4, printed p.4 (PDF page 6), and following paragraph on p.5; complete Chapter 2, Sections 2.1–2.4, printed pp.8–11, Definitions 10–11 and Theorems 12–19 with proofs and intervening warnings.
sources.support: Independent author-hosted 33-page treatment; complete relevant extracted text read, including Theorems 13–18 and their choice qualifications.

contents.name: Definition 4: Dependent Choice
Definitions 10–11: category vocabulary and Baire spaces
contents.support: Use standard contained-in-countable-union definition of meagre; do not restrict meagre sets to F_sigma sets.

contents.name: Theorem 12: a nonempty Baire space is nonmeagre
contents.support: Nonempty hypothesis is essential; absorbed in the stronger local open-set characterization.

contents.name: Theorem 13 and following DC qualification: complete metric Baire
contents.support: Replace compressed ball construction by tagged centre-radius states, closed-ball containment and direct epsilon proof.

contents.name: Theorem 14: completeness of the discrete sequence metric
contents.support: Miller reciprocal metric used in place of dyadic metric; both have the same finite-prefix proof.

contents.name: Theorem 15: a complete non-Baire sequence space under a Dedekind-finite real-set hypothesis
contents.reason: Model-dependent failure witness requires a proved Dedekind-finite set supplier; it belongs to the symmetric-model page and cannot be assumed by this root.

contents.name: Theorem 15 proof: open dense successor witnesses
contents.support: Generalize order successor to a serial relation as in Theorem 18; retain single-cylinder existential selection.

contents.name: Theorem 16 and warning: countable unions of meagre sets spend choice
contents.support: Used only to delimit the definition and warn against selecting countably many decompositions; union theorem not asserted here.

contents.name: Theorem 17: complete separable metric spaces are Baire in ZF
contents.reason: The separable, enumerated-dense-set theorem is a different sufficient-hypothesis interface and is already assigned to the general Baire treatment; it is not needed for the arbitrary-space equivalence.

contents.name: Theorem 18 (Blair): Baire Category Theorem equivalent to DC
Theorem 18 proof: least-index extraction
contents.support: Use Miller unrestricted witness indices, explicitly recurse by their minimum rather than silently reindexing.

contents.name: Theorem 19 and surrounding functional-analytic consequences
contents.reason: Open-mapping, closed-graph and uniform-boundedness comparisons require functional-analytic statements and independence proofs beyond this exact DC/metric-Baire replacement pair; no such comparison is asserted or used.
